maya: Kicking off a small slice deploy to prod at 15:40 UTC (10m window). Runtime + batching-config bump for slice-7. @liam are you available to monitor?

liam: Yep, I can watch. Success criteria? rollback readiness?

maya: Success = p50 <= 65ms for /generate, errors < 0.5% on the slice, no regression on top-10 prompt set. Rollback plan: cut traffic to 0% for slice-7 and reapply previous model variant.

maya: Quick smoke checklist (run before and after):
```
# smoke commands
k run smoke-check --env prod --slice slice-7
curl -sS https://console.redwood/api/v1/health | jq '.status'
python infra/quick_eval.py --model gpt-small-opt --prompt-file smoke/prompts.txt
# check recent logs: aws s3 ls s3://redwood-logs/prod/slice-7/ --recursive | tail -n 20
```

deploy-bot: Deploy started for slice-7 — canary 5% -> 25% over 2m. uid=deploy-2177770001 :rocket: 

ops-jen: Watching latency and token-cost dashboards. I'll call out if p95 or billed tokens spike >10% vs baseline.

liam: Seeing a p99 tail bump at +1200ms at minute 3, small error spike 0.9% on reranking route. I'm pausing canary and cutting to 0% now.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic scaled to 0% for slice-7 by policy (automatic fallback).

liam: Root cause looks like a kernel path regressing under certain sequence lengths. Re-applying previous kernel variant and re-run smoke.

maya: Good catch. Re-deploy when ready. Keep me posted.

deploy-bot: Redeploy completed with kernel=stable-v2, canary 5% -> 25% over 2m.

ops-jen: After redeploy p50=58ms, p95=220ms, errors 0.12% — within thresholds. Token-cost flat.

liam: Verified smoke eval set — no quality regression. I'm marking slice-7 as "verified" for this window. Will keep standby for 30m before pushing to full rollout.

maya: Thanks all. I uploaded the quick notes + commands to the runbook: https://console.redwood/runbooks/slice-deploys#slice-7 (added kernel troubleshooting steps).

sanjay: Saved the relevant logs to s3://redwood-archives/deploy-2177770001/ and attached the smoke output: s3 link. :white_check_mark: 

maya: Closing thread for now. Standby mode ON for 30m, ping @liam or @ops-jen if anything odd shows up. :thumbsup:
